name: Scan to BIM
description: Proposes the floors, walls, doors and windows of a building from a point cloud you have open in BimCraft. Every proposal shows how far it sits from the scanned points, in millimetres. You accept, edit or reject each one; accepting draws them in the model as one undo step. A starting drawing from a scan, to be checked against the building: not a survey.
author: CadCraft
